task.title: Classify optional PR diagnostics without blocking merges

scope.owned_layer: Auto-integrator status-rollup requiredness enrichment, narrow diagnostic provenance classification, UNSTABLE eligibility, focused tests, contract, and task evidence.
scope.not_changing: Review authority, exact-head binding, trailer enforcement, branch protection, merge bypasses, canonical task state, live supervisor runtime, or direct disposition of PR #4741.

implementation.requiredness: Fetch CheckRun and StatusContext isRequired through GitHub GraphQL and join it to gh pr view statusCheckRollup by (__typename, name/context).
implementation.diagnostic_provenance: Ignore a failing or pending context only when isRequired is exactly false and workflowName is the known read-only Canonical Review Attestation Audit issuer.
implementation.actual_ci_boundary: An optional Branch CI job such as Python packaging provision still blocks on failure; isRequired=false alone is insufficient to classify a check as diagnostic.
implementation.ambiguity_policy: Query errors, malformed payloads, unmatched identities, absent or non-boolean requiredness, missing or unknown workflow provenance, and conflicting duplicate identities all fail closed. Duplicate identities are required if any matching node is required.
implementation.merge_state: UNSTABLE is eligible only after the full enriched rollup is green under the classifier; BLOCKED, DIRTY, stale-head, and all other disallowed states remain blocked.
implementation.auditability: Dry-run and merged result details name every explicitly non-required diagnostic excluded from blocking.

allows: PR #4741-shaped failed audit with isRequired=false and the exact diagnostic workflow provenance
UNSTABLE merge state only after all non-diagnostic checks are green
blocks: GraphQL failure or unmatched GraphQL context
conflicting duplicate identity when any node is required
optional failure without known diagnostic workflow provenance
